emails.goal: Thank them for the visit, name the gap, hand them a free quote
emails.subject: {{first_name}}, one thing was missing from your file
emails.subjectAlt: Your {{vehicle_model}} is covered. You are not.
emails.preheader: No coverage on file. That is fixable in about four minutes, online, without talking to anybody.

emails.goal: Reframe the repair math without fear-mongering
emails.subject: That bill had a number on it. The next one might not.
emails.preheader: A covered repair at our store costs you zero. Not reduced. Zero.

emails.goal: Own the grievance: no call centers, no pressure, 100% online
emails.subject: Nobody is going to call you
emails.subjectAlt: This email has no salesperson attached to it
emails.preheader: That is not an oversight. That is the product.

emails.goal: The $0-at-our-store deductible, the strongest dealer-specific hook
emails.subject: Your deductible disappears when you come back
emails.subjectAlt: A number that goes to zero
emails.preheader: Bring the car back to Ferrario and the deductible on a covered repair goes away.

emails.goal: Payment plan mechanics, remove the affordability objection
emails.subject: 0% for {{payment_term}} months, no credit check
emails.preheader: 5% down. The rest spread out at zero percent. No credit pull.

emails.goal: Educate on exclusionary vs listed-component, the real quality differentiator
emails.subject: The good kind of coverage has an ugly name
emails.preheader: Most plans list what is covered. Ours lists what is not. That gap is the whole game.

emails.goal: Differentiate from direct-response VSC telemarketers without naming anyone
emails.subject: We are not the people from the commercial
emails.subjectAlt: Your car's extended warranty, and other famous phone calls
emails.preheader: Not a robocall. Not a monthly subscription. The store that already fixes your car.

emails.goal: Ancillary benefits: roadside, towing, rental reimbursement
emails.subject: The parts of coverage nobody talks about
emails.subjectAlt: Roadside, rental, and the rest of it
emails.preheader: Coverage is not only for the day the transmission goes. Most of it is for smaller, more annoying days.

emails.goal: The honest why-buy-now: eligibility is mileage and age gated
emails.subject: Why we keep saying now
emails.preheader: Eligibility runs on mileage and model year. Both of yours are moving in one direction.

emails.goal: Graceful close, permission-respecting, leaves the door open
emails.subject: Last one from us on this
emails.subjectAlt: We are going to stop emailing you about this
emails.preheader: Ten emails is a reasonable limit. Your quote link stays alive regardless.
